text_block_list.text:
—Summer. On the beach near the training 
camp, we discussed what kind of training 
to conduct for the Kikuka Sho, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! I'm honestly super anxious! Truth 
is, I don't know how much help I can 
really be to Bright.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, only my pose looks confident... 
Inside, I'm filled with nothing but 
anxiety...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I can help you in a medium-distance race 
where the final stretch decides it, but 
when it comes to long distance—and 3000 
meters at that—I'm not so confident...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's even more impossible for me than 
Ryan-chan~. After winning the Derby, I 
went on break, so I haven't run any 
long-distance races.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
If you're looking for someone to coach for 
the Kikuka Sho, aren't there others much 
better suited for it? It's obvious if you 
think about it, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'll leave the rest to her! Do 
your best, Bright-chan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I see... When it comes to long 
distances, there are girls who are better 
suited for it than Ines or me.”

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, why don't we rely on Bright for 
that? After all, the Mejiro family has all 
kinds of Umamusume!"

If the race she's aiming for changes, the 
coach should probably be changed to match.

Having established a new training regimen, 
we decided to take on the challenge. 
—Heading toward autumn.
